✨ teleop | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: Enabling intuitive, wireless teleoperation of robot arms using readily available mobile devices or VR headsets.
✨ Key Features: • WebXR-based teleoperation via phone or VR headset • Python server for receiving device data • Integration with robot arm controllers • Basic, xArm, and ROS 2 interfaces • Support for ROS 2 cartesian_controllers, MoveIt Servo, and IK solutions
📖 Summary: This repository enables teleoperation of robot arms using a phone or VR headset through a web interface powered by WebXR. It translates device orientation and position data into robot control commands, supporting various robot interfaces and ROS 2 integration.
